dialogues.speaker: Incense
dialogues.text: (The incense slowly rising into the air... It seems familiar somehow.)

dialogues.speaker: Incense
dialogues.text: (...Emilie checked last night. Turns out, it's Spirit Borneol.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wasn't this incense originally in Lucien's room? It must've been moved here before nightfall yesterday...
